name: AI Search Analytics & Tracking
author: Airefs

sections.description:
Track AI search impressions and clicks from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude & other LLMs and improve your website’s visibility across all AI search results.

Privacy

  • Deployed on Cloudflare for secure, performant delivery.
  • User sign‑up flows run on Convex.
  • Analytics data is processed in Tinybird and stored on AWS servers within the EU.
sections.installation:
1. Upload airefs-ai-search-analytics-tracking.zip via Plugins → Add New, or extract to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create an account on https://app.getairefs.com/auth/sign-up
  4. Go to Settings on https://app.getairefs.com/ and copy your Access Token.
  5. Go to Settings → Airefs Tracking, enter your Access Token, and click Save.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin store cookies or credentials?

No. We do not store any cookies or authentication headers containing credentials.

How is user data protected?

All IP addresses and User‑Agent strings are anonymized before transmission.
